coverage.name: San Miguel County
limitations: Both posted sample ballots are marked 'PROOF 2026-09-10' (after the county certification deadline). Neither contains a San Miguel County ballot issue or question. Only two ballot styles (004-1 and 001-2) are posted.
The TABOR notice is not yet posted. No participating-entities list or IGA was found; the county's CivicPlus agenda portal could not be browsed.
News and CitizenPortal items about county questions 1A/1B (ECAP/MHAP 5.25% limit waiver, road and bridge) refer to the Nov 2025 election, not 2026.

coverage.name: Mountain Village (town)
limitations: Rechecked 2026-10-12: the county elections page still posts only the same two general-election sample ballots (style 004-1 and the R-1 School District style 001-2). No TABOR notice, ballot-content certification or participating-entities list is posted, and none appears among the county Document Center files posted since (IDs up to 14847). Neither posted style has a Town of Mountain Village section, and neither is identified as Mountain Village's precinct.

Rechecked 2026-10-10: the town election page still covers only the November 4, 2025 special election (Ballot Issue A, lift ticket tax). The town runs some elections separately from the county's coordinated election, because it has non-resident property-owner electors.

The July, August and September 2026 Mountain Village Minute summaries mention no town ballot referral for Nov 3, 2026, and no October 2026 summary is posted. This is not an official statement that there are no measures.
On 2026-09-26 the town's election blog category also covered only 2025.
Rechecked 2026-10-12: the town election page still covers only the November 4, 2025 special election (Ballot Issue A) and posts nothing for 2026.

Rechecked 2026-10-10: the town's posted 2026 resolutions still end at Resolution 0812 Series 2026, and none refers a question to the Nov 3, 2026 ballot. Resolution No. 212 Series 2026 cancelled the town's regular municipal election. The public notices page lists no notices.

The town's 2026 ordinances (through 0814 Series 2026, reviewed 2026-09-26) include no Nov 2026 ballot referral. The ordinances page could not be opened on 2026-10-10 (too many requests), so it was not rechecked.

Rechecked 2026-10-12: the town resolutions page is unchanged (latest Resolution 0812 Series 2026), the ordinances page lists nothing after Ordinance 0814 Series 2026, and neither refers a question to the November 3, 2026 ballot.

coverage.name: Telluride (town)
limitations: Based on the Town Clerk's official page: 'The Town does not have an election scheduled for November 3, 2026.' The next regular election is November 2, 2027.

The county sample ballot for Precinct 001 (Precinct 1 = within the Town of Telluride per the precinct map), style 001-2, is a PROOF dated 2026-09-10. It has no Town of Telluride question; its only local measure is Telluride School District R-1 Ballot Issue 5A (school mill levy override, not housing).
The legacy domain www.telluride-co.gov did not resolve or was blocked. Pages were read on telluride.gov. The 2026 special municipal election (June 30, 2026) was for council seats only.
